articles.title: Biomechanical Comparison of Triple and Quintuple Percutaneous Achilles Tendon Lengthening Techniques: A Short Report.
articles.authors: Zhu M, Marty EW, Myerson MS, Li S
articles.outcomes: Tendon lengthening, ankle dorsiflexion angle, load at maximal dorsiflexion, and tendon rupture rate
articles.take_home: The study found no statistically significant difference between the new quintuple hemi-section technique and the traditional triple hemi-section technique for Achilles tendon lengthening or ankle movement, though the quintuple technique achieved slightly greater lengthening on average. Larger studies are needed to determine if the differences observed have any clinical importance.

articles.title: Clinical Outcomes After Proximal Medial Gastrocnemius Recession and Stretching in 151 Patients With Chronic Plantar Fasciitis: A Prospective Cohort Study With 2-Year Follow-Up.
articles.authors: Riiser MO, Fjellheim MI, Skot-Hansen N, Molund M
articles.population: Adults aged 18-75 years with chronic plantar fasciitis lasting at least 12 months, failed non-operative treatment, and tight calf muscles
articles.outcomes: Foot-specific quality of life (MOxFQ score), pain (VAS), general health-related quality of life (EQ-5D-5L), ankle movement range, and complications
articles.take_home: Patients who had proximal medial gastrocnemius recession surgery combined with calf stretching showed substantial improvements in pain and quality of life at 2 years, with low complication rates. However, because this study had no control group, the improvements cannot be definitively attributed to surgery alone.

articles.title: Radiographic and clinical outcomes of flat-cut versus chamfer talar components in INFINITY total ankle arthroplasty.
articles.authors: Karas E, Garibaldi R, Harrington M, Morales S, Lan R, Demetracopoulos CA, et al.
articles.population: Patients undergoing primary total ankle arthroplasty
articles.outcomes: Periprosthetic cyst formation, talar component subsidence, reoperation-free survival, revision-free survival
articles.take_home: Flat-cut and chamfer-cut talar components in ankle replacement showed similar rates of cyst formation and need for further surgery, though flat-cut components had more revisions overall; however, the small number of revisions means this finding should be interpreted carefully.

articles.title: Patient-reported outcomes after primary offset-V versus scarf osteotomy for hallux valgus: A register-based two-year follow-up.
articles.authors: Silfverdal G, Brokopp J, Coster MC, Broden C
articles.population: Patients with moderate-to-severe hallux valgus undergoing shaft osteotomy
articles.outcomes: SEFAS score and EQ-5D-3L quality of life measure at baseline, 1 year and 2 years; operative time; need for lateral release
articles.take_home: Both offset-V and scarf osteotomy operations improved symptoms comparably over two years, with both groups reporting similar improvements in foot function and quality of life. Offset-V achieved these equivalent results with shorter operative times.

articles.title: A cadaveric investigation of the posterior tibial tendon transfer: Which route provides the shortest distance to the lateral cuneiform?
articles.authors: Alugo O, Holt K, Bigney E, Mayer W, Thomson E, Matz J
articles.outcomes: Tendon distance in tunnel (TDIT) measured for three posterior tibial tendon transfer routes
articles.take_home: The interosseous route placed over the extensor retinaculum preserved the most tendon length, which may help ensure better fixation when tendon length is limited during foot drop surgery.
